name: research-skills
tagline_zh: 写字的人会喜欢：research-skills。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Six agent skills for the research chain — scope, source, appraise, synthesize, report. Every claim carries how far the sourcing actually reached, and hedges survive into the write-up exactly as stated.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。
